a: A compiled (non-source) module that stops naming icons keeps its old refs through watch rebuilds
A build lets a package's built table override its source table, which dev explicitly avoids
A namespace named `all` cannot be loaded as `virtual:weasel-icons/<namespace>`, and nothing says so
An extensionless `./icons.gen` import is not followed when the generated file is `.tsx`, `.jsx`, `.mts` or `.mjs`
Identifiers in TS type and declaration positions count as "other uses" of `icon`, and `import icon = …` does not shadow
The dev table watcher can throw out of a chokidar listener
b: A package's declared (built) table overrides the source table beside the icons.gen a module imports, so a stale `dist/icons.table.json` wins
Library mode under esbuild has no check that the `@icon` annotations survived, so a minified esbuild build ships unannotated refs silently
`declaredTable`'s unbuilt fallback takes the first source table under `src` while dev's `packageTables` takes all of them
Identifiers in type positions outside `TSTypeAnnotation` are reported as non-call uses of `icon`
A JSX element naming the imported `icon` binding is neither rewritten nor warned about
`watchTables` reads the table's directory outside its `try`, so a table whose directory vanishes throws out of the watcher listener
